title: Royal Bank of Canada Announces Agreement to Acquire Yarra Capital
summary: Royal Bank of Canada agreed to acquire Yarra Capital Management, an Australian asset manager with about A$18 billion in AUM, expected to close in Q1 2027.
body_markdown:
Under the terms of the agreement, RBC will acquire full ownership of Yarra, subject to the satisfaction of certain closing conditions, including regulatory approval. The release did not state a purchase price. The release describes the acquisition as a springboard for the growth ambitions of RBC Global Asset Management (RBC GAM), the bank's asset management division.


"The investment and distribution capabilities of Yarra are complementary to our asset management business," said Damon Williams, CEO of RBC Global Asset Management. Dion Hershan, Executive Chairman of Yarra Capital Management, said: "After a long and deliberate search to find the right business partner for the future, we are thrilled about our agreement to join RBC."


## Why It Matters for RY


According to the release, RBC Global Asset Management is focused on expanding its capabilities and diversifying its market share, including outside of North America. RBC said the announcement demonstrates its commitment to growing in Australia and the Asia-Pacific region, and that the transaction, once closed, is expected to further strengthen the bank's position as a leading global asset manager.
